display_name: Phase1 类别一致性恢复网络
description: 源域训练多候选特征类别预测器，只采用与高置信类别一致的恢复信号，固定后进行 Phase1 地面开发测试。
authorization: 用户要求研发不同路线的星地恢复网络，只看 Phase1 地面训练测试、使用 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；六场景下降不超过 3%，同时核对百分点和相对百分比口径。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI Python/Torch, FP32, TF32 off; original Phase1 Tri-SIG-TIME immutable release

data.representation: Phase1 physical-channel source IQ and frozen expert probabilities, embeddings and spectra
data.label_map_ref: Six Phase1 transmitter classes; L_s labels only, U_s teacher pseudo-labels
data.tx_sets_ref: Six original classes; L_s labels and high-confidence U_s clean-teacher pseudo-labels
data.validation_ref: Existing complete R07 source cache, IDs compared with Tri-SIG-TIME source contract
data.support_query_ref: Phase1 original fixed cross_rx126000 and cross_both42000; no support
data.leo_config_ref: R07 2.462 GHz source views and Phase1 six fixed practical test views
data.target_panel: 168000 Phase1 physical records x seven views
data.actual_training_labels: L_s true labels; U_s teacher pseudo-labels with clean confidence >=0.95; no U_s labels, V or test IQ
data.augmentation: Source clean and three independently seeded practical residual-channel views, 25 MHz and 2.462 GHz, 30 dB reference SNR, no equalization

permissions.regime: Phase1 L_s true labels, U_s clean teacher pseudo-labels and source IQ only; no V/test during source training
permissions.query_use: Frozen per-record received IQ and frozen expert/F outputs only; no clean or label at inference
permissions.claim_scope: Previously observed single-seed Phase1 development test, not blind

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen DURA, Tri-SIG-TIME SSL, source-trained boundary/feature experts and 698-256-6 source semantic consensus model
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Frozen F/DURA provenance and exact expert checkpoint and source router asset SHA-256
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Four frozen experts; source semantic model uses L_s labels and U_s teacher pseudo-labels
checkpoint.selection_rule: Source validation epoch 20, confidence >=0.9; if class differs from DURA select matching feature, boundary, then raw expert; otherwise DURA

execution.gpu_policy: CPU real-weight source smoke; shared lock, at most two same-user restoration GPU workers and two same-user compute processes per GPU, >=12000 MB; GPU B128 source smoke then fixed seven-view predictions
execution.stop_rule: Source/model mismatch, smoke failure, nonfinite output, resource ambiguity or incomplete predictions preserves artifacts; no automatic retry or performance-based stop

metric_names: Tri-SIG-TIME raw clean, per-scene raw and restored accuracy, macro F1 and clean-relative gap
dimensions: 168000 Phase1 ground test physical records x seven views
metrics_plan.targets_ref: Each of six restored practical scenes within 3 percentage points of same reader raw clean; restored clean degradation at most 1 percentage point

notes: 输入为四专家类别概率、原始与 DURA 对数能量、四个冻结 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL 归一化中间向量及原始/残差频谱，共 698 维；类别预测器 698–256–6。
源域用 L_s 真标签和 U_s 高置信 clean 教师伪标签；源信道模拟不等于已验证的真实卫星链路。
源验证固定 epoch 20、类别置信度 0.9；源留出每视图 1596 条有效记录，三个视图分别净修复 6、5、21 条，干净混合目标不变。先前探针的源记录可能重叠，基础专家见过源记录。
测试只读取每条 Phase1 接收 IQ；全部七视图预测固定后才读取 TX 真值。
方案受先前已观察的 Phase1 测试结果启发；本轮测试非独立盲测，同时报告百分点与相对百分比下降。

rows.method: Source semantic-consensus router with frozen classifier embeddings and spectra
rows.purpose: Select an expert only when its frozen classifier agrees with a high-confidence source-trained class estimate
rows.seed_notes: Source sampling 2026110251, split 2026110252, physical channel 2026110253, RX/day hardware 2026110254, model 2026110255, fitting order 2026110256; fixed original Phase1 test views
rows.scenario: Source clean and independent practical low-suburban/mid-urban/low-urban views; fixed Phase1 clean and six practical received views
rows.budget_ref: Source validation selects epoch 20 and confidence 0.9; no target-time updates
